app.name: unbound
app.title: unbound intake
app.description: AI-guided intake assistant for athlete support

chat.title: Intake assistant

intro.title: What this conversation is for
intro.body: I will ask you about your sport, your history and your complaints, and turn that into a structured record for your coach.
intro.point1: Nothing to prepare. If you do not know something, skip it and come back to it later.
intro.point2: You can add reports, scans, screenshots or a WhatsApp export. I only read them once you ask me to.
intro.point3: Nothing enters your record without your confirmation, and your coach reviews all of it before it counts.

chat.openReport: See what has been collected so far
chat.progressLabel: {sectionsDone} of {sectionsTotal} sections done, {required} of {requiredTotal} required fields complete

errors.fileKept: The file is kept, nothing was lost

sharing.title: Before you send this to your coach
sharing.body: May your physiotherapist or sports physician receive a summary of this intake in the secure workspace they use? Without this, your medical details stay with your coach only, and your practitioner sees just your contact details.
sharing.keep: Keep it with my coach only
sharing.note: You can change this later by asking your coach.

intake.title: Intake
intake.intro: Send us what you already have. The assistant reads it and only asks about what is still missing.
intake.conflicts: {count, plural, one {1 contradiction between your documents. The assistant will ask you which value is right.} other {# contradictions between your documents. The assistant will ask you which values are right.}}
intake.documentsHint: Medical reports, scans, your training plan, test results, screenshots or a WhatsApp export. PDF, JPEG, PNG, text or CSV.
intake.documentSummary: {fields, plural, one {1 field found} other {# fields found}}, {verified} with a verified quote
intake.submittedBody: Your coach will review your file and get in touch. The documents you sent stay stored alongside the data taken from them.
intake.submittedNotion: A follow-up task and an invoice line were created for your coach.
intake.duplicateDocument: You already sent {filename}, so nothing was read again. What it contained is above.
intake.unreadHint: Not read yet. Nothing enters your record until you tap this.
intake.alreadyReadDocument: You sent {filename} before and I already read it then. What was in it is above.

extraction.nothingFound: I read {filename}, but I could not find any details to add. You can tell me instead.
extraction.found: I read {filename} and found {count, plural, one {1 detail} other {# details}}. Please check.

retention.indefinite: Your record is kept for as long as your care continues, and can be deleted on request.
retention.months: Your record is retained for {months} months and can be deleted on request.

home.startBody: Chat about your symptoms, pain and history. Upload scans or reports and the assistant does the rest.

auth.headline: Structured intake,
auth.intro: Tell us how you feel. The assistant builds a complete, review-ready record for your coach.
auth.consent: I consent to my health data being processed for the purpose of this intake.
auth.noMatch: Those details do not match an account.
auth.coachIntro: Sign in to review athlete intakes.
auth.coachFooter: Accounts are created by the practice. Ask an administrator to reset your password if you cannot sign in.

review.conflictsTitle: {count, plural, one {1 contradiction} other {# contradictions}} between sources
review.conflictsBody: These block approval. The system has not chosen; that is up to you.
review.summaryEmpty: Summarise the intake into what the record says, what stands out, and what still needs checking.
review.summaryDisclaimer: Generated from the file. Facts come from the source documents; observations are interpretation, not diagnosis. The raw documents are kept and can be traced per field below.
review.documentsNote: The raw files are kept permanently alongside the data taken from them.
review.approveNotSubmitted: Only possible once the athlete has submitted the intake.
review.approveBody: Records a report version with your name on it. After that the file is fixed and the athlete can no longer change it.

report.title: Intake report
report.summaryDisclaimer: Automatically generated, not written by a clinician. Facts come from the documents provided; observations are interpretation, not diagnosis.
report.footerCorrections: Corrections belong in the intake system, not on this printout. Consent version {version}
report.footerSharingYes: ; the athlete consented to sharing with practitioners.
report.footerSharingNo: ; the athlete did not consent to sharing with practitioners.
